name: substrate-read-internal
description: Internal-only substrate read gateway for SupportTicketDO. Wraps ctx.substrate (findEntities, getEntity, searchMemory) and the HTTP /v1/me/substrate/source-artifacts route. Sanitises agent-provided q strings before hitting substrate FTS (rewrites email addresses to their local part, strips '#' and punctuation that substrate's index does not handle as standalones).
